operating_point.chosen_on: calibration split (20 percent of train, by hash)
operating_point.note: Thresholds were chosen on the calibration split and applied unchanged to held-out. Where the calibration negatives are fewer than 100, a one percent budget cannot be resolved and the artefact says so rather than claiming it was met.

urgency_pressure.rule: lowest false positive rate among scorers with recall at or above the floor

prototype_knn.threshold_source: calibration split, FPR budget on calibration negatives

linear_probe.threshold_source: calibration split, FPR budget on calibration negatives
linear_probe.score_semantics: Platt scaled probability. The transform was fitted on the calibration split; the Brier score and reliability bins above describe the held-out output after scaling.

notes: Weak supervision: the corpus supplies the malicious or benign label; the cue rule only selects the element a segment is evidence about. Held-out metrics are measured on rows neither the probe nor the kNN thresholds saw.

provenance.source: teacher-labelled real text (operator dataset, Nazario/SpamAssassin corpus, authored seed rows)
provenance.verifier: second prompt (same model), not an independent verifier

label_gate.quote_verification: every kept label carried an exact phrase verified verbatim in the segment

credential_request_independent_check.outcome: credential_request removed from the vocabulary at elements/3

independent_check_provenance.transport_boundary: only the sampled segments left the machine; no other corpus text was sent

research_items.credential_request: needs a definition and reviewed quote-verified positives that separate 'asks the reader to supply a credential' from templated 'verify your account' phrasing
research_items.threat: needs a reviewed, quote-verified positive set before it can re-enter; the teacher labels were teacher-heavy (11 vs 2 same-model) and produced only 5 union rows

provenance.licence: project-owned labels over operator-provided corpus text
